# Yandex
> Search engine and internet services platform for finding information, navigating places, communicating, and using everyday online tools.

Yandex provides web search alongside maps, mail, translation, browser, cloud storage, advertising, and developer-facing APIs and documentation across its ecosystem.

## Search and Discovery
- [Yandex Search](https://yandex.com/): Main search engine for webpages, images, videos, and answers.
- [Images](https://yandex.com/images/): Image search for finding pictures and visually similar content.
- [Video](https://yandex.com/video/): Video search and discovery across indexed sources.
- [Maps](https://yandex.com/maps/): Interactive maps, places, routes, and local business discovery.
- [Weather](https://yandex.com/weather/): Weather forecasts and conditions for cities and regions.
- [Translate](https://translate.yandex.com/): Text and webpage translation between multiple languages.

## Communication and Productivity
- [Mail](https://mail.yandex.com/): Webmail service for personal email and communication.
- [Disk](https://disk.yandex.com/): Cloud storage for files, sharing, and synchronization.
- [Calendar](https://calendar.yandex.com/): Online calendar for scheduling events and reminders.
- [Telemost](https://telemost.yandex.com/): Video meetings and online conferencing service.
- [Documents](https://360.yandex.com/docs/): Online document editing and collaboration tools.
- [Yandex 360](https://360.yandex.com/): Productivity suite combining mail, disk, calendar, and collaboration.

## Maps and Location Services
- [Yandex Maps](https://yandex.com/maps/): Mapping service with routes, transit, and place information.
- [Map Constructor](https://yandex.com/map-constructor/): Tool for creating and embedding custom maps.
- [Traffic](https://yandex.com/maps/traffic): Live traffic conditions and congestion information.
- [Route Planning](https://yandex.com/maps/routes): Driving, walking, and transit route building.
- [Metro](https://yandex.com/metro/): Metro maps and route planning for supported cities.

## Browser and Consumer Apps
- [Yandex Browser](https://browser.yandex.com/): Web browser with security, translation, and smart features.
- [Alice](https://yandex.com/alice/): Voice assistant for search, tasks, and smart device interactions.
- [Start Page](https://yandex.com/): Entry point to search and Yandex services.
- [Games](https://games.yandex.com/): Browser-based games catalog and platform.
- [Music](https://music.yandex.com/): Music streaming and discovery service.
- [Books](https://books.yandex.com/): Digital books and reading service.

## Developers
- [Yandex Developer](https://yandex.com/dev/): Central portal for APIs, SDKs, tools, and technical documentation.
- [Maps API](https://yandex.com/dev/maps/): APIs and documentation for maps, geocoding, and routing.
- [Metrica](https://yandex.com/support/metrica/): Analytics platform documentation and implementation guides.
- [Direct API](https://yandex.com/dev/direct/): API documentation for managing advertising campaigns programmatically.
- [Webmaster](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/): Tools and documentation for site indexing and search visibility.
- [SpeechKit](https://yandex.com/dev/speechkit/): Speech recognition and synthesis APIs for developers.
- [Cloud Documentation](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/): Technical documentation for Yandex Cloud services.

## Advertising and Analytics
- [Yandex Direct](https://direct.yandex.com/): Advertising platform for search and display campaigns.
- [Direct Help](https://yandex.com/support/direct/): Documentation and guides for advertisers using Direct.
- [Yandex Metrica](https://metrica.yandex.com/): Web analytics platform for traffic and behavior analysis.
- [Metrica Help](https://yandex.com/support/metrica/): Setup instructions, reports, and analytics reference.
- [Webmaster](https://webmaster.yandex.com/): Search performance tools for site owners and SEO monitoring.
- [Webmaster Help](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/): Documentation for indexing, diagnostics, and search appearance.

## Cloud and Infrastructure
- [Yandex Cloud](https://yandex.cloud/): Cloud platform for infrastructure, data, and AI services.
- [Cloud Docs](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/): Product documentation, tutorials, and service references.
- [Cloud Console](https://console.yandex.cloud/): Management console for cloud resources and services.
- [Cloud CLI](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/cli/): Command-line interface documentation and usage guides.
- [Cloud API Reference](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/api-design-guide/): API usage guidance and service integration patterns.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://yandex.cloud/en/solutions): Solution overviews for common cloud workloads.

## Support and Help
- [Yandex Support](https://yandex.com/support/): Central help hub for Yandex products and services.
- [Mail Help](https://yandex.com/support/mail/): Support articles for using and configuring Yandex Mail.
- [Disk Help](https://yandex.com/support/disk/): Help center for cloud storage, sharing, and sync.
- [Browser Help](https://browser.yandex.com/help/): User documentation for browser features and settings.
- [Maps Help](https://yandex.com/support/maps/): Support documentation for maps and navigation features.
- [Translate Help](https://yandex.com/support/translate/): Help articles for translation features and usage.

- [Advertising Rules](https://yandex.com/legal/adv_rules/): Policies and requirements for advertising content.
